description: The ⋮ menu at the end of a pod's row in the Kubernetes view's Pods table, and the namespaces popover in its top bar.
opens: Click the namespaces button in the Kubernetes top bar

actions.does: Opens the confirmation dialog "Delete pod <name>?" naming the namespace, the context, whether it is a remote cluster and what controls the pod; nothing is deleted until its Delete button is pressed.
Opens the stronger confirmation "Force delete pod <name>?" (the cluster forgets the pod at once, its containers possibly still running on their node); its confirm button reads "Force Delete".

parts.name: namespaces popover
parts.shows: A popover under the namespaces button: a check "All namespaces", a separator, then a scrolling list (up to about 420 px tall) of a check per namespace, sorted by name.

actions.does: Adds it to or removes it from the namespaces shown; any number at once.
